title: Vernacular? I Barely Know Her: Challenges with Style Control and Stereotyping

bias_targets.methodology: Prompting LLMs to answer questions about sensitive societal issues (e.g., Black Lives Matter, law enforcement, marijuana, affirmative action) exclusively in African American English (AAE), and analyzing the generated text for implicit stereotypes and racist rhetoric across zero-shot and few-shot in-context learning setups.

Evaluating the models' ability to accurately generate and control dialect using a distantly supervised, lexicon-based scoring metric for AAE, and observing the models' tendency to rely on exaggerated, stereotyped phonetic spellings (e.g., 'aight', 'fo sho', 'dey') rather than authentic vernacular.
